# REMAINING_WORK

The Awtsmoos renews the work from moment into moment bright;
items remain open until evidence closes them in light.

## Discovery
- [ ] Capture current git/worktree status and concurrent modifications.
- [ ] Search all app/source paths for movie/animation/scene/timeline/Three.js/Canvas/camera/particle capabilities.
- [ ] Enumerate every true movie-capable app and classify 2D, 3D, hybrid, editor, or supporting tool.
- [ ] Trace entry/import/runtime ownership for each app.
- [ ] Identify existing shared timeline/schema/compiler code and duplication.
- [ ] Write exact target-file inventory in `DISCOVERY.md`.

## Architecture
- [ ] Choose shared-core strategy from evidence.
- [ ] Define/confirm canonical movie schema.
- [ ] Define validation and AI-repairable errors.
- [ ] Define timeline/keyframe/easing behavior.
- [ ] Define renderer-neutral object/scene vocabulary.
- [ ] Define persona/adapters for each app without flattening identity.

## Implementation
- [ ] Implement/extend shared movie core.
- [ ] Implement/extend 2D render path for shapes, text, charts/tutorials, people, particles.
- [ ] Implement/extend 3D path for geometry, people, particles, lights, cameras, cuts/motion.
- [ ] Implement/extend declarative AI movie compiler.
- [ ] Integrate every discovered movie app.
- [ ] Improve mobile-first prompt, preview, scene, timeline, and inspector UX.
- [ ] Create a real 180-second showcase project with at least 10 scenes and broad feature coverage.

## Verification
- [ ] Syntax/static checks on all touched JS.
- [ ] Existing relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Add focused tests for newly shared logic where coverage is absent.
- [ ] Assert showcase total duration = 180 seconds.
- [ ] Assert scene-boundary localization and representative interpolation.
- [ ] Browser-load every integrated route with no new console errors.
- [ ] Verify desktop layout.
- [ ] Verify mobile viewport and touch-target usability.
- [ ] Load showcase and seek/play through representative times across full duration.

## Closure
- [ ] Re-read every touched file in full.
- [ ] Audit tab indentation and source module size.
- [ ] Compare planned vs actual work.
- [ ] Resolve every required delta.
- [ ] Record known limitations and final evidence in `VERIFICATION_LEDGER.md`.
- [ ] Confirm no required item remains open.
